title: Skills & tools — make it feel like Projects

steps.headline: Does this revised tab now look like the other three Projects tabs?
steps.changed: Removed the narrow settings column, duplicate screen heading and stacked wells. The tab now fills the same width as Files and Instructions & Memories, with one explainer, the same small group headings and full-width rows.
steps.notice: The fourth tab and project switcher are unchanged. Bundled items now read as rows in the same rhythm as the instructions tab; their automatic-use state is visible under each name.
steps.risk: Still a visual prototype with sample entries; these switches do not save.

steps.path: Skills & tools → expanded plugin and items needing setup
steps.headline: Does the revised plugin grouping and missing-device section fit the tab's style?
steps.changed: Research Kit uses a full-width Projects row, with its skills and server inset beneath it. Missing personal skills and server connections use the same row shape rather than a separate settings box.
steps.notice: The previously approved four-tab phone behavior stays. The explainer links to the items that need setup; the lower rows remain reachable by scrolling.
steps.risk: The Add locally and Set up locally buttons are visual placeholders. No device files or connections are changed.
